items.text:
It has pronouns. 

I want to recommend this game, it has a lot of good qualities. However it seems confused about what it should be. I don't want indepepth sex and interpersonal mechanics when we are scraping by in the depths of space.

I want a space game about space salvaging not whatever the boring social mechanic is.

This game has a great amount of depth mostly created by a terrible interface. There are other games that have all of the same mechanics but can present them in a way that is easy to grasp. This is the opposite, you have to fight with the ui to make it do what you want for no good reason when other games have already solved this complexity. I'm thinking in terms of inventory management, atmosphere, and character needs. The nav interface is amazing.
items.text_zh:
它有代词。

我想推荐这款游戏，它有很多优点。然而，它似乎搞不清自己应该是什么。当我们在太空深处勉强求生时，我不想要深入细致的性和人际机制。

我想要一款关于太空打捞的太空游戏，而不是某种无聊的社交机制。

这款游戏有大量的深度，主要是由一个糟糕的界面造成的。还有其他游戏拥有所有这些相同的机制，但能以容易理解的方式呈现出来。这恰恰相反，你不得不毫无正当理由地与UI搏斗，让它做你想做的事，而其他游戏早已解决了这种复杂性。我指的是物品栏管理、大气环境和角色需求方面。导航界面非常棒。

observations.description: 加入了与太空打捞无关的社交/人际机制
observations.evidence: I don't want indepepth sex and interpersonal mechanics when we are scraping by in the depths of space
observations.evidence_zh: 当我们正在太空深处勉强求生时，我不想要深入的性爱和人际交往机制。
